observations: Three photos show a truck container filled with multiple used car engines stacked on wooden pallets.
The engines vary in size, shape, and condition; some appear clean, others show rust, grime, or wear.
No visible branding, model numbers, or VIN tags are readable on any engine in the photos.
The container is labeled 'CARROZZERIA INDUSTRIALE' and 'SMVELES' with Italian text and contact details, suggesting the seller is Italian or based in Italy.
The watermark 'G.O. MERCHANTS LTD' is visible across the images, likely from the seller.
The engines appear to be from different vehicles, possibly including sedans or hatchbacks, but no specific car models are visible.
The seller claims to have engines from 2008-2015 models, including RX350, ES350, IS250, and Toyota Camry, but no visual evidence supports this.
